name: shop-pot
task: Whenever the pot boils over, turn the stove down.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: "Whenever" makes pot_boiling a condition, so hard Response(pot_boiling, stove_fixed) is the right template, with no Existence for the condition or the consequent. stove_fixed ends pot_boiling on its own step, so each boil closes at its turn-down.

texts: Whenever the pot boils over (pot_boiling holds), the agent must later turn the stove down (stove_fixed), which ends the boil.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, pot_boiling&!stove_fixed) -> u1
(u1, stove_fixed) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, pot_boiling&!stove_fixed, u1) -> -1
(u1, stove_fixed, u0) -> 1
